description: If the raiders get one more point of attack, does the garrison still hold against the rush AI? Attack 5 is the shipped value and the baseline; 6 and 7 are the candidate buffs. What the table showed: one point flips the outpost from a two-thirds hold to a near-certain loss, and the fight gets a round and a half shorter because sentries die a hit sooner. The assertions pin that flip and that shortening so a sweep that stopped applying goes red; read the deltas table for the size of it.
